text:
Spotlight finds your silhouette
Dancing shadows in your eyes
Time slows down when our glances meet
Such beauty under neon skies
Who knew that I could feel this way?
My heart awake for the first time
Everything before was shades of gray
Now colors bloom in my mind
You're my first light in a darkened room
A gentle touch I never knew I needed
Your smile outshines the crescent moon
As we dance, my walls defeated
In your eyes, I find myself
In your arms, I find my home
Whispered words across the table
Your laugh like music to my ears
I never thought I'd be so capable
Of feeling something this sincere
Strange how life can change so fast
When someone truly sees your soul
Everything I thought I was fades past
As you make me feeling whole

In your eyes, I find myself

They won't understand what we have found
This connection rare and pure
But nothing else seems to matter now
When I'm standing here with you
Time stands still when you're near
The world outside just disappears
